record.one_liner: Hosted Git repository platform with issues, pull requests, CI (Actions), and collaboration tools for software teams.
record.auth_notes: The fetched auth page lists fine-grained and classic personal access tokens, GitHub App tokens, OAuth app tokens, and GITHUB_TOKEN for Actions. All are sent as "Authorization: Bearer TOKEN". Username and password are not supported. GitHub Apps and OAuth apps support third-party flows. The auth page doesn't mention the app-JWT step (GitHub Apps sign a JWT to get installation tokens), so I listed JWT from background knowledge.
record.access_notes: Inferred, not verified on a fetched page: a free account can create a PAT, GitHub App, or OAuth app with no review. I didn't fetch a page on plan requirements or rate limits.
record.blocker: none. Rate limits apply, and organization resources may need org-owner approval of apps or tokens. Neither was verified on a fetched page.
